body.label: Trigger
body.html: An imbued ally or object within 5 units is targeted or used.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Increase one Defense, damage, or movement value granted by that Imbuement by 1 for the triggering effect.

surges.html: One ally affected by this Reaction gains +1 Defense until its next turn.
If this Reaction affects a maintained supernatural effect, reduce or end one Rank 0 component of it.
